question.text: Mr. Rajan has received Rs. 50 lakh from property sale and wants to invest in equity but is worried about market timing. Which systematic facility would allow him to park in a debt fund and gradually move to equity?

answer.text: STP from a liquid/debt fund to an equity fund of the same AMC
Lump sum investment in balanced fund

explanation.text: The Logic: STP allows Mr. Rajan to invest the lump sum in a liquid/debt fund and systematically transfer a fixed amount to an equity fund periodically. This gives the benefit of rupee cost averaging while the uninvested portion earns debt fund returns. The Trap: SIP requires funds from bank account at regular intervals — it can't handle a lump sum deployment. STP is designed exactly for this purpose. Cross-Exam Context: STP mechanism and use cases are tested in V-A and X-A.
